name: Manifold Tool
text: A tool that, with a Magic action while touching it, can change into any Artisan's Tools you choose. You are proficient with whichever form it takes.

name: Mask of Changed Appearance
text: A mask with 3 charges that regains 1d3 daily at dawn. Spending a charge (Magic action) lets you make minor cosmetic changes to your face for 1 hour, during which the mask is Invisible. If you spend the last charge, a d20 roll of 1 destroys it.

name: Mechanical Wonder
text: A family of wind-up constructs in several forms. Winding one takes 1 minute of Utilize actions each turn, and each variety stays active for its own duration and follows its own stat block.

name: Moon-Touched Sword
text: When drawn in darkness, this weapon glows with moonlight, giving Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for 15 more feet.

name: Mystery Key
text: A key that has only a 5 percent chance of opening any lock it is put into. It vanishes after it unlocks something.

name: Mythallar Bracelet
text: Three beads on a bracelet. Plucking one (Magic action) gives Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks for 1 minute. The bracelet loses its magic after all three beads are used.

name: Orb of Direction
text: An Arcane Focus. With a Magic action while holding it, you learn which way is magnetic north, but only where magnetic north exists.

name: Orb of Time
text: An Arcane Focus. With a Magic action while holding it, you learn whether it is morning, afternoon, evening, or nighttime. It works only on the Material Plane.

name: Perfume of Bewitching
text: A single-use vial of perfume. Applying it (Magic action) gives you Advantage on Charisma (Deception and Persuasion) checks against creatures within 5 feet for 1 hour.

name: Pipe of Smoke Monsters
text: With a Magic action while smoking the pipe, you exhale a puff of smoke shaped like a creature that fits in a 1-foot cube. The shape fades after a few seconds.

name: Pole of Angling
text: Functions as a Pole. With a Magic action while holding it, you can change it into a fishing pole (with hook, line, and reel) and back again.

name: Pole of Collapsing
text: Functions as a Pole. With a Magic action while holding it, you can collapse it into a 1-foot rod for storage or expand it back, though it only extends as far as the space allows.

name: Pot of Awakening
text: Plant an ordinary shrub in this pot and let it grow for 30 days. The shrub then becomes an Awakened Shrub that is Friendly to you and obeys your commands, and the pot breaks.

name: Potion of Comprehension
text: Drinking it casts Comprehend Languages on you for 1 hour.

name: Prosthetic Limb
text: A magic replacement for a lost limb that works exactly like the original body part. You can attach or detach it with a Magic action, but it can't be removed against your will while you are alive.

name: Rival Coin
text: A coin with 1 charge that regains its charge at dawn. A Magic action tosses it, and the result (heads on an even die roll, tails on odd) decides the effect: heads makes one visible creature within 60 feet risk 2d4 Psychic damage and Disadvantage on its next attack, and tails costs you 1d4 Psychic damage.

name: Rope of Mending
text: A 50-foot rope. With a Magic action, loose pieces that touch each other knit back into one rope, but each lost or destroyed section permanently shortens it.

name: Ruby of the War Mage
text: Press this ruby against a Simple or Martial weapon for 10 minutes to make that weapon a Spellcasting Focus for you. It can only be removed by a Magic action, by destroying the weapon, or by ending attunement.

name: Shield of Expression
text: A Shield with a carved face on its front. With a Bonus Action while bearing it, you can change the face's expression.

name: Silvered Weapon
text: When you score a Critical Hit with this weapon against a shapechanger in its true form, the weapon deals one extra damage die.

name: Smoldering Armor
text: Harmless, odorless smoke rises from this armor while you wear it. It is purely cosmetic.

name: Sniper's Bracelet
text: With a Magic action while touching it, you change this weapon into a bracelet and back (the bracelet can't attack). In weapon form, if it has no ammunition, it creates one piece of magic ammunition for each ranged attack, which vanishes after the attack.

name: Spell Component Ring
text: With a Magic action, store one Material component of a prepared spell that has no cost and isn't consumed. While you wear the ring, you can use that component without a free hand. It holds one component at a time.

name: Staff of Adornment
text: Up to three Tiny objects weighing 1 pound or less can float above the tip of this staff while you hold it. You can make them spin or turn in place.

name: Staff of Birdcalls
text: 10 charges. With a Magic action, spend 1 charge to make a bird sound that can be heard up to 120 feet away. It regains 1d6 + 4 charges at dawn, and if you spend the last charge, a d20 roll of 1 destroys it.

name: Staff of Flowers
text: 10 charges. With a Magic action, spend 1 charge to grow a flower from soil within 5 feet or from the staff itself. It regains 1d6 + 4 charges at dawn, and if you spend the last charge, a d20 roll of 1 destroys it.

name: Sweeping Broom
text: With a Magic action and a command word, the broom animates and sweeps a 20-foot square within 60 feet of you until you use another Magic action to stop it.

name: Sylvan Talon
text: While you carry this weapon, you understand Fey and they understand you. Once per dawn, you can use a Magic action to cast Message from it.

name: Talking Doll
text: Spend a Short Rest with the doll within 5 feet to record up to six phrases of six words or fewer, each with a trigger condition that must happen within 5 feet of the doll. The phrases are lost when attunement ends.

name: Tankard of Sobriety
text: Nonmagical alcoholic drinks poured into this tankard won't make you drunk. It has no effect on magical liquids or harmful substances like poison.

name: Trick Weapon
text: With a Magic action while touching it, you change this weapon into a mundane item and back. The item is chosen by the DM or rolled on a d10 table (bracelet, comb, spoon, and so on), and it can't attack while in that form.

name: Unraveling Cloak
text: With a Magic action, you unbutton the hood and the cloak leaves a thread trail behind you for up to 100 miles. Others need a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check made with the Search action to spot the thread. Rebuttoning it (Magic action) stops the trail, and teleporting destroys the thread.

name: Veteran's Cane
text: With a Bonus Action while holding it, you transform this walking cane into a Longsword, or change the Longsword back into a cane.

name: Walloping Ammunition
text: When this ammunition hits a target, that target must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or be knocked Prone.

name: Wand of Conducting
text: 3 charges. With a Magic action, spend a charge to wave the wand and create orchestral music audible up to 120 feet away until you stop waving. It regains all charges at dawn, and if you spend the last charge, a d20 roll of 1 destroys it.

name: Wand of Pyrotechnics
text: 7 charges. With a Magic action, spend a charge to create a harmless, one-second burst of colored light visible up to 120 feet away, with a loud crackle heard up to 300 feet. It regains 1d6 + 1 charges at dawn, and if you spend the last charge, a d20 roll of 1 destroys it.

name: Magewright's Gloves
text: While you wear these attuned gloves, you craft Alchemist's, Brewer's, Calligrapher's, Cartographer's, Glassblower's, and Jeweler's nonmagical items twice as fast.

name: Mariner's Armor
text: While you wear this armor, you have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed. If you start your turn underwater at 0 Hit Points, you regain 1d4 Hit Points, but the armor can't heal anyone again until the next dawn.

name: Martialist's Quarterstaff
text: 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. Spend 2 charges to cast Searing Smite (DC 13), or spend 1 charge to give the staff the Thrown property until the end of your next turn. Spend 1 charge for Advantage on a melee attack, and if it hits, the target makes a DC 13 Strength save or falls Prone.

name: Mind Sharpener
text: 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. When you fail a Constitution save to keep Concentration, you can use a Reaction and spend a charge to succeed instead.

name: Nature's Mantle
text: A cloak that works as a Spellcasting Focus for Druid and Ranger spells. While you stand in a Lightly Obscured area, you can Hide as a Bonus Action even while being directly observed.

name: Necklace of the Beastly Familiar
text: Rarity depends on the gemstone. The necklace can cast Find Familiar once per dawn. With a Magic action while your familiar is within 60 feet, you can change it into a Beast form for 10 minutes, with the form set by the gem.

name: Orb of Divination Detection
text: A glass orb that glows bright green for the duration of any Divination spell targeting you. It also works as an Arcane Focus.

name: Orb of Sorcery
text: With a Magic action while holding it, you regain up to 2 expended Sorcery Points. You can use this once per dawn. It also works as a Spellcasting Focus for Sorcerer spells.

name: Pipes Of Pestilence
text: Playing the pipes with a Magic action summons one Swarm of Corrupted Rats within 60 feet, which stays Friendly and under your control while you keep playing each round. When your control ends, the swarm vanishes and the pipes can't be used again until dawn.

name: Poison Soaked Kukri
text: A Bonus Action coats the blade with poison for 1 minute or until it hits. The target makes a DC 13 Constitution save or takes 2d8 Poison damage and becomes Poisoned for 1 minute. You can use this coating once per dawn.

name: Potion of Dragon's Breath
text: Drinking it grants Dragon's Breath for 1 minute (save DC 13, no Concentration). The damage type depends on the potion's color: black is Acid, blue is Lightning, green is Poison, red is Fire, and white is Cold.

name: Potion of Fire Breath
text: After drinking, a Bonus Action lets you exhale fire at a target within 30 feet. The target makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 4d6 Fire damage on a failure or half on a success. The effect ends after three uses or 1 hour.

name: Potion of Pugilism
text: For 10 minutes after drinking, each Unarmed Strike you hit with deals an extra 1d6 Force damage.

name: Potion of Tirelessness
text: For 24 hours after drinking, you don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend that time in quiet, conscious focus.

name: Quaal's Feather Token
text: A single-use token. A d100 table decides its type, such as Anchor, Bird, Fan, Swan Boat, Tree, or Whip, and each type has its own one-time effect and rarity.

name: Quiver of Ehlonna
text: Three compartments hold up to 60 Arrows or Bolts, 18 Javelins, or 6 long objects such as bows, Quarterstaffs, or Spears, all while the quiver weighs no more than 2 pounds. You can draw any item as you would from an ordinary quiver or scabbard.

name: Reliquary of Dawn
text: While you wear this talisman, you are immune to the effects of Eventide, a Lorwyn setting effect.

name: Reliquary of Twilight
text: While you wear this talisman, you are immune to the effects of Morningtide, a Shadowmoor setting effect.

name: Repeating Shot
text: Gives +1 to attack and damage rolls for ranged attacks with this weapon. It ignores the Loading property, and if it has no ammunition, it creates one piece of magic ammunition for each ranged attack, which vanishes after it hits or misses.

name: Repulsion Shield
text: +1 bonus to AC while you wield it. It has 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. When a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, you can use a Reaction and spend a charge to push that attacker up to 15 feet away.

name: Returning Weapon
text: Gives +1 to attack and damage rolls with this thrown weapon. After you make a ranged attack with it, it flies back to your hand.

name: Ring of Candor
text: While you wear the ring, you gain +5 to Wisdom (Insight) checks. You can also cast Zone of Truth (save DC 13) from it once per dawn.

name: Ring of Dedicated Focus
text: When you fail a Constitution save to keep Concentration, you can roll up to two unexpended Hit Dice and add the total to the save. The rolled Hit Dice are then expended.

name: Rod of the Pact Keeper
text: Rarity sets the bonus: +1 for Uncommon, +2 for Rare, or +3 for Very Rare. The bonus applies to Warlock spell attack rolls and spell save DCs. With a Magic action, you can regain one spell slot once per Long Rest.

name: Saddle of the Cavalier
text: While you sit in this saddle on a mount, attacks against the mount have Disadvantage, and you can't be knocked off against your will. The dismount protection stops while you are Incapacitated.

name: Silencing Satchel
text: 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. Spend one with a Magic action to curse a creature within 60 feet: it makes a DC 15 Charisma save or its mouth is sealed for 1 minute, blocking Verbal spells, potions, and eating or drinking. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Spell-Refueling Ring
text: A Bonus Action recovers one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower. You can use it once per dawn.

name: Spell-Slinger's Puppet
text: With a Bonus Action, the doll levitates to a point within 30 feet and hovers for 1 minute. You can move it with another Bonus Action, and while it is within 30 feet, you can speak through its mouth, which lets you cast spells with Verbal components even if you can't speak.

name: Spiked Shield
text: Shield Bash: with the Attack action, make an attack with the shield for 2d6 + your Strength modifier Piercing damage on a hit. Spike Salvo: once per dawn, use a Magic action for a 30-foot Cone where creatures make a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 3d6 Piercing damage on a failure or half on a success.

name: Staff of Skulls
text: The rarity sets the power. Ominous (Uncommon) casts Chill Touch, Chattering (Rare) lets you impose Disadvantage on a visible creature's attack roll with a Reaction, and Pulverizing (Very Rare) makes a Humanoid within sight make a DC 17 Constitution save or take 10d8 Necrotic damage and fall Prone, once per dawn.

name: Staff of the Adder
text: A Bonus Action turns the head into a venomous snake for 1 minute. Its attack has 5 feet of reach, dealing 1d6 Piercing plus 3d6 Poison damage on a hit. The snake head has AC 15 and 20 HP, and if it drops to 0 the staff is destroyed.

name: Sword of Vengeance
text: Gives +1 to attack and damage rolls. The sword is cursed, and attuning extends the curse: you have Disadvantage on attacks with other weapons, and taking combat damage can force a DC 15 Wisdom save to make you attack that creature until one of you falls.

name: Sync Ring
text: When you attune, pick a blank book you are touching. Anything you write with the ring hand is copied into that book, and attunement ends if the book runs out of blank pages or stays on another plane for more than 24 hours.

name: Thayan Spell Tattoo
text: A tattoo holding a level 1 to 3 spell that is always prepared, and you can cast it with any slot of the right level. Without a spellcasting feature, the spell uses DC 13 and +5 attack bonus. It can also be cast once without a slot or components, after which the tattoo vanishes.

name: Thespian's Playbill
text: While you hold this playbill, Study action Intelligence checks gain a bonus equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1).

name: Thief's Thimble
text: When you trigger a trap while wearing it, the thimble takes the damage instead. It has 30 Hit Points and breaks at 0, letting any leftover damage through.

name: Wand of Enthralling
text: 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. While you hold it, spend one charge to cast Enthrall (save DC 15).

name: Wand of Freshness
text: 4 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn. While you hold it, spend one charge to cast Purify Food and Drink.

name: Wave-Swept Weapon
text: Rarity sets the bonus. Barnacled (Uncommon) gives +1 to attack and damage, plus a Magic action to turn fresh water into saltwater. Aquatic (Rare) raises the bonus to +2 and adds light.

name: Wraps of Unarmed Power
text: Rarity sets the bonus to unarmed attack and damage rolls: +1 for Uncommon, +2 for Rare, or +3 for Very Rare. You can choose Force damage or the normal damage type for those strikes.

name: Mage Breaker
text: Gives +1 to attack and damage rolls. When you hit a creature that is Concentrating with this weapon and deal damage, that creature has Disadvantage on its Concentration saves.

name: Magen Handbell
text: A Magic action rings the bell to summon a Terran Magen for up to 1 hour, until it dies, or until you dismiss it. The bell recharges after 1d6 days. When the magen starts a turn Bloodied, roll a d6, and on a 6 it goes berserk.

name: Mage's Manacle
text: A Magic action binds a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet that is Grappled or Incapacitated (DC 15 Dexterity save). The bound creature is Restrained, moves with you, and stays bound for 8 hours. You can use it once per dawn, and only Disintegrate can destroy the manacle.

name: Masquerader's Brooch
text: A Bonus Action projects an illusion over your clothes, armor, and gear for 1 hour. You choose how extensive it is, but it ends if you remove the brooch and doesn't survive a physical inspection.

name: Mythallar Cloak
text: 10 charges, regaining 1d10 at dawn. A Bonus Action spends 1 charge to gain a 30-foot Fly Speed for 1 minute. Once per turn, a hit with an attack can add 1d4 Radiant damage, and you fall if you are still aloft when the magic ends.

name: Namer's Needle
text: Gives +1 to attack and damage rolls. On a hit, you can force a DC 15 Wisdom save so the target speaks its name, and saying the target's name can turn a hit into a Critical Hit. Each of these effects can be used once per dawn.

name: Prismatic Rune
text: Each Long Rest, choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. The rune has 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn, and spending one changes the damage type of a spell you cast that deals damage.

name: Salubrious Armor
text: Gives +1 to AC. Whenever you regain Hit Points, the bonus rises to +2 until the end of your next turn.

name: Scarlet Spellbook
text: While attuned, you can use it as a Spellbook and an Arcane Focus. When you use Arcane Recovery, you also regain 2d6 plus half your Wizard level in Hit Points, and Memorize Spell can swap one extra level 1+ spell.

name: Scholar's Anchoring Bangle
text: When you make an Intelligence check using a skill you are proficient in with the Study action, a d20 roll of 9 or lower counts as a 10. Once per dawn, you can use a Reaction to succeed on a failed Concentration save.

name: Scroll of Protection
text: The type of creature it protects against is chosen from a d100 table. A Magic action creates a 5-foot Emanation that lasts 5 minutes and keeps creatures of that type out. A creature of that type next to it can try a DC 15 Charisma save to overcome the effect.

name: Secret Keeper's Circlet
text: A Magic action sets a trigger within 24 hours. When it happens, the circlet erases your memories from the moment you set it until the trigger. You can use it once per dawn, and only a Wish spell restores the erased memories.

name: Spell Duelist's Trophy
text: Hitting with a melee spell attack lets you cast Dispel Magic on that target, once per dawn. You can also cast spells without Somatic components using a spell slot, and the trophy grants the Mage Hand cantrip.

name: Stormwalker's Cloak
text: 3 charges, all regained at dawn. Spending 1 charge casts Hellish Rebuke (DC 13) and lets you choose Lightning or Thunder damage. You have Resistance to Lightning and Thunder damage.

name: Tentacle Rod
text: A Magic action sends three tentacles at creatures within 15 feet, each making a +9 melee attack for 1d6 Psychic damage on a hit. If all three hit the same target, it makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or is Restrained, taking 3d6 Psychic damage at the start of each of its turns until it succeeds.

name: Thayan Sword
text: Gives +1 to attack and damage rolls. The sword has 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn, and spending one casts Searing, Thunderous, or Wrathful Smite (DC 15). Once per dawn, if reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead.

name: Wand of Misdirection
text: 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. While you hold it, spend one charge to cast Mislead.

name: Wand of Slumber
text: 7 charges. While you hold it, cast Catnap for 3 charges or Sleep (save DC 15) for 1 charge. It regains 1d6 + 1 charges at dawn, and if you spend the last charge, a d20 roll of 1 destroys it.

name: Wand of Teeth
text: 10 charges, regaining 1d10 at dawn. A Magic action spends up to 3 charges on a 30-foot Cone of spectral teeth: each creature makes a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking Piercing damage equal to a d8 per charge spent and becoming Poisoned until your next turn on a failure. If you spend the last charge, a d20 roll of 1 destroys it.

name: Windskiff
text: 3 charges, all regained at dawn. A Magic action spends one charge to transform the jewelry into a sail-powered vehicle for up to 1 hour. In vehicle form, it has AC 12, 30 Hit Points, and 40 feet of Speed, and it glides above surfaces.

name: Niko's Mace
source: Uni and the Hunt for the Lost Horn
text: 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn. While you hold it, spend one charge to cast Summon Celestial, using +9 to hit with spell attacks.

name: Nolzur's Marvelous Pigments
text: A box with 1d4 pots of pigment and a brush. Spend one pot and concentrate for 10 minutes inside a 20-foot Cube to paint 3D objects and terrain. If your Concentration breaks or you leave the Cube early, everything you painted vanishes.

name: Potion of Greater Invisibility
text: After drinking, you have the Invisible condition for 1 hour.

name: Robe of Thayan Arcana
attunement: by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard
text: While you wear the robe, your spell save DC and spell attack bonus each increase by 1. When you roll spell damage, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2. It also works as a Spellcasting Focus.

name: Spell-Fuelling Armor
text: When you roll spell damage while wearing the armor, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2. After a Short Rest, you can recover expended spell slots whose levels total 3 or less, once per dawn.

name: Spirit Board
text: 3 charges, regaining 1 at dawn. While you touch the planchette, you can spend 1 minute to cast a divination spell from the board, such as Augury (1 charge) or Commune (3 charges), with the spirits answering by moving the planchette to letters or words.

name: Staff of the Lost
text: Works as a Quarterstaff with +1 to attack and damage rolls and 3 charges. Spend one to cast Maze (DC 18) or Teleport. It is cursed: you never know which way is north, have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Survival) navigation checks, and each charge you spend has a 1 in 20 chance of summoning 1d4 Minotaurs.

name: Tramontane Armor
text: Gives +1 to AC, and looks like a robe. Difficult Terrain made of snow, ice, rubble, or undergrowth doesn't cost you extra movement. A Magic action activates Grasping Tendrils, which makes creatures in a 20-foot Emanation attempt a DC 15 Strength save or be Grappled and pulled toward you.

name: Workshop Wrecker
text: A Magic action activates a bouncing metal ball for 1 minute, which you can stop with a command word within 30 feet. Creatures in its area make a Dexterity save each turn for Bludgeoning damage, with the DC and damage set by its area: from DC 18 and 6d6 + 5 in a 15-foot Cube down to DC 14 and 1d6 + 1 in a 100-foot Cube. It recharges at dawn.

name: Moonblade
attunement: by a Creature of the Weapon’s Choice
text: The first rune gives +1 to attack and damage rolls, and each later rune adds another property. A Moonblade that rejects you curses you with Disadvantage on D20 Tests for 24 hours or until the curse is ended.

name: Scroll of Titan Summoning
text: A Magic action reads the scroll to summon a titan picked from a d100 table within 1 mile. The titan is Hostile to everyone else and vanishes at 0 Hit Points. If the space is too small, the summoning fails and the scroll is wasted.

name: Staff of the Spirit Aegis
text: A Quarterstaff with +3 to attack and damage rolls that grants Resistance to Necrotic damage. A Magic action creates a 30-foot Emanation where chosen creatures get Resistance to Cold, Necrotic, and Psychic damage, and undead have Disadvantage on attacks against them.

name: Sword of Answering
text: Gives +3 to attack and damage rolls. While you hold it, a Reaction lets you make one melee attack with Advantage against a creature that damaged you, and that attack ignores the target's Resistance or Immunity to that damage.

name: Tome of the Dragon
text: Contains the ritual to turn a dragon or its body into a dracolich. You need two level 5 spell slots or to be a dragon yourself, along with about 80,000 GP of supplies and a long ritual split among those performing it.

name: Tome of the Stilled Tongue
text: While attuned, you can use it as a Spellbook and an Arcane Focus. With a Bonus Action, you can cast a spell written in the tome without a spell slot or Verbal or Somatic components, once per dawn.

name: Traveler's Pearl
text: Using a command word while holding it casts Teleport from the pearl once per dawn.

name: Orb of Damara
text: While attuned, a Magic action exhales a 15-foot Cone of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison that deals 6d6 damage (DC 18 Dexterity save for half). A 20-foot Fear Aura imposes Frightened on enemies who fail a DC 18 Wisdom save, and you gain a 60-foot Fly Speed.

name: Orb of Dragonkind
text: An artifact orb that still draws dragons toward its holder and gives some control over them. Peering into it (Magic action) forces a DC 15 Charisma save: success gives you control of the orb while you stay attuned, and failure lets the orb impose its own effect on you.

name: Queen Ehlissa's Marvelous Nightingale
text: A Magic action brings this mechanical songbird to life for 10 minutes, during which it sings audibly for 300 feet. While it sings, it has 6 charges for spells (DC 18), including Compulsion, Delayed Blast Fireball, Greater Restoration, and Slow, and it projects a Zone of Truth-style aura.

name: Spirit-Binding Censer
text: 10 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn. Cast spells from it at DC 18, such as Banishment (4 charges), Dispel Magic (3), or Bless (1). A Magic action creates protective smoke, and a creature dying nearby can have its soul trapped for 100 years.

name: Sword of Kas
text: Gives +3 to attack and damage rolls, and it Critically Hits on a 19 or 20. If the sword doesn't taste blood within 1 minute of being drawn, its wielder makes a DC 15 Charisma save or is dominated by it.

name: Universal Pantograph
text: Put a nonmagical item in the 2-foot box and close the lid to get a duplicate. A Magic action can enlarge it to hold a Medium creature, and with 100 GP of diamond dust, it casts Clone, which takes 120 days to finish. If it contains no clone, it is destroyed after 999 years in a Feywild bog.

name: Wand of Orcus
text: An artifact that gives +3 to AC while held, and works as a +3 Mace that adds 2d12 Necrotic damage. A creature other than Orcus that attunes must make a DC 17 Constitution save or take 10d6 Necrotic damage, dying and possibly becoming a Zombie.

name: Wave
text: An artifact trident that gives +3 to attack and damage rolls, and a natural 20 adds 21 Necrotic damage. It sends a Dominate Beast spell (DC 20) at a Beast with a Swim Speed once per charge, and has Globe of Invulnerability at level 9 once per dawn.

name: Whelm
attunement: by a Dwarf or a Creature Attuned to a Belt of Dwarvenkind
text: An artifact warhammer that gives +3 to attack and damage rolls and has Thrown range of 60/180 feet. A ranged hit deals an extra 1d8 Force damage, or 4d8 against Constructs, Elementals, and Giants, and it returns to your hand. A Magic action can also strike the ground to send a shock wave.
